items.source: Once downloaded, follow the INSTALL.txt instructions from the unpacked archive. In summary, there is a spring script (spring.bat for Windows) in a bin/ directory in the .zip file. Alternatively, you can use java -jar with the .jar file (the script helps you to be sure that the classpath is set correctly).
items.translation: 下载后，请遵循解压存档中的INSTALL.txt说明。 简而言之，在.zip文件的bin/目录中有一个spring脚本（Windows 下为spring.bat）。 或者，您也可以使用java -jar配合.jar文件（该脚本可确保类路径设置正确）。

items.source: The Spring Boot CLI includes scripts that provide command completion for the BASH and zsh shells. You can source the script named spring (_spring for zsh) or put it in your personal or system-wide bash completion initialization. On a Debian system, the system-wide scripts are in <installation location>/shell-completion/<bash|zsh> and all scripts in that directory are executed when a new shell starts. For example, to run the script manually if you have installed by using SDKMAN!, use the following commands:
items.translation: Spring Boot CLI 包含为 BASH 和 zsh shell 提供命令补全的脚本。 您可以 source 名为 spring 的脚本（对于 zsh 为 _spring），或者将其放入您个人或系统范围的 bash 补全初始化中。 在 Debian 系统上，系统范围的脚本位于 <installation location>/shell-completion/<bash|zsh>，该目录中的所有脚本在新 shell 启动时都会执行。 例如，如果您使用 SDKMAN! 安装了它，可以手动运行该脚本，请使用以下命令：

items.source: Spring Boot dependencies use the org.springframework.boot group id. Typically, your Maven POM file inherits from the spring-boot-starter-parent project and declares dependencies to one or more starters. Spring Boot also provides an optional Maven plugin to create executable jars.
items.translation: Spring Boot 依赖项使用 org.springframework.boot` 组 ID。通常，您的 Maven POM 文件继承自 spring-boot-starter-parent 项目，并声明对一个或多个 启动器 的依赖项。Spring Boot 还提供了一个可选的 Maven 插件 用于创建可执行的 jar 包。

items.source: Spring Boot dependencies can be declared by using the org.springframework.boot group. Typically, your project declares dependencies to one or more starters. Spring Boot provides a useful Gradle plugin that can be used to simplify dependency declarations and to create executable jars.
items.translation: 可以使用 `org.springframework.bootgroup 声明 Spring Boot 依赖。通常，您的项目会声明一个或多个starter的依赖。Spring Boot 提供了一个有用的Gradle 插件，可用于简化依赖声明并创建可执行的 jar 包。

items.source: The preceding instructions install a local instance of spring called the dev instance. It points at your target build location, so every time you rebuild Spring Boot, spring is up-to-date.
items.translation: 前面的指令安装了一个名为dev的本地spring实例。它指向您的目标构建位置，因此每次重新构建 Spring Boot 时，spring都是最新的。

items.source: Homebrew installs spring to /usr/local/bin.
items.translation: Homebrew 将 spring 安装到 /usr/local/bin。

items.source: Scoop installs spring to ~/scoop/apps/springboot/current/bin.
items.translation: Scoop 将 `spring` 安装到 `~/scoop/apps/springboot/current/bin`。

items.source: Spring Boot can be used with “classic” Java development tools or installed as a command line tool. Either way, you need Java SDK v17 or higher. Before you begin, you should check your current Java installation by using the following command:
items.translation: Spring Boot 可与“经典”Java 开发工具配合使用，或作为命令行工具安装。无论哪种方式，您都需要 Java SDK v17 或更高版本。开始之前，请使用以下命令检查当前的 Java 安装：

items.source: If you are new to Java development or if you want to experiment with Spring Boot, you might want to try the Spring Boot CLI (Command Line Interface) first. Otherwise, read on for “classic” installation instructions.
items.translation: 如果您是 Java 开发的新手，或者想要尝试 Spring Boot，您可以先试试 Spring Boot CLI（命令行界面）。否则，请继续阅读“经典”安装说明。

items.source: You can use Spring Boot in the same way as any standard Java library. To do so, include the appropriate spring-boot-*.jar files on your classpath. Spring Boot does not require any special tools integration, so you can use any IDE or text editor. Also, there is nothing special about a Spring Boot application, so you can run and debug a Spring Boot application as you would any other Java program.
items.translation: 您可以像使用任何标准 Java 库一样使用 Spring Boot。为此，请将相应的 spring-boot-*.jar 文件包含在您的类路径中。Spring Boot 不需要任何特殊的工具集成，因此您可以使用任何 IDE 或文本编辑器。此外，Spring Boot 应用程序也没有什么特别之处，因此您可以像运行和调试任何其他 Java 程序一样运行和调试 Spring Boot 应用程序。

items.source: Although you could copy Spring Boot jars, we generally recommend that you use a build tool that supports dependency management (such as Maven or Gradle).
items.translation: 虽然您可以复制 Spring Boot jar 包，但我们通常建议使用支持依赖管理的构建工具（如 Maven 或 Gradle）。

items.source: Spring Boot is compatible with Apache Maven 3.6.3 or later. If you do not already have Maven installed, you can follow the instructions at maven.apache.org.
items.translation: Spring Boot 兼容 Apache Maven 3.6.3 或更高版本。如果您尚未安装 Maven，可以按照maven.apache.org上的说明进行操作。

items.source: More details on getting started with Spring Boot and Maven can be found in the Getting Started section of the Maven plugin’s reference guide.
items.translation: 有关使用 Spring Boot 和 Maven 的更多详细信息，请参阅 Maven 插件参考指南中的入门部分。

items.source: Spring Boot is compatible with Gradle 8.x (8.14 or later) or 9.x. If you do not already have Gradle installed, you can follow the instructions at gradle.org.
items.translation: Spring Boot 兼容 Gradle 8.x（8.14 或更高版本）或 9.x。如果您尚未安装 Gradle，可以遵循gradle.org上的说明进行操作。

items.source: The Gradle Wrapper provides a nice way of “obtaining” Gradle when you need to build a project. It is a small script and library that you commit alongside your code to bootstrap the build process. See docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/gradle_wrapper.html for details.
items.translation: Gradle Wrapper 提供了一种很好的方式来“获取” Gradle，以便构建项目。它是一个小型脚本和库，您将其与代码一起提交，以启动构建过程。有关详细信息，请参阅 docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/gradle_wrapper.html。

items.source: More details on getting started with Spring Boot and Gradle can be found in the Getting Started section of the Gradle plugin’s reference guide.
items.translation: 有关使用 Spring Boot 和 Gradle 入门的更多详细信息，请参阅 Gradle 插件参考指南中的入门部分。
